rounds.text: Despite the apparent allure of headline earnings growth, Mother Nutri Foods Ltd conceals severe fundamental vulnerabilities that render its reported profitability highly suspect. The company exhibits a disastrous cash conversion ratio of -3.75x for March 2026, generating a massive negative operating cash flow of Rs -45 Cr and free cash flow of Rs -46 Cr [E17, E18, E19]. This catastrophic divergence between profit and actual cash collection is compounded by deteriorating operational efficiency, as working capital days have ballooned from 76.0 days to 113 days [E36]. Furthermore, borrowings have surged significantly to Rs 42 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 23 Cr a year prior, elevating financial risk while operating margins display an inconsistent trend over the last two quarters and years [E15, E16, E22]. Institutional confidence is actively evaporating, evidenced by a heavy negative money flow and foreign institutions slashing their holdings from 11.99% to 4.76% in a single quarter alongside a drop in domestic institutional stakes [E25, E26, E27]. Alarmingly, Screener flags that the company might be capitalizing interest costs while stubbornly refusing to pay any dividends despite its reported profits [E34, E35]. Conceded: [E10] records a high compounded profit growth of 113% over 3 years alongside a strong historical ROE track record [E33].
